* WHEN...From 6 PM Monday to 6 AM AKST Tuesday.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property, and
cause power outages. Travel will be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds are will be over Adak,

system moves through the Bering. Winds will gradually lighten but

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 15 at 4:40AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
properties.description:
Confidence is growing in the potential for a strong coastal storm
to take a more northerly track through the Bering Sea mid-week.
Depending on the final track of the system, minor to moderate
coastal flooding impacts may be a possible for parts of the West
Coast, with sea level rises between 3 to 7 ft possible. In
addition to the coastal impact potential, periods of moderate to
heavy snow and strong winds could begin as early as Tuesday night
and last into Friday. The combination of winds and heavy snow
could lead to reduced visibilities at times. We will continue to
monitor this system closely and provide updates as additional
information becomes available.
